purpose: Machine-readable authority for which fleet products may receive native mobile work, enforced by tests/Test-MobileScope.ps1. Mobile identifiers are effectively permanent: an Apple bundle identifier cannot be changed after the first build is uploaded to App Store Connect, and Android treats a changed applicationId as a different application. A product whose name is known to be temporary must therefore not have any long-lived mobile identity created for it, not even a placeholder.
rosterNote: Every repo in repo-standard.json -> repos must appear below, except the names in repo-standard.json -> excluded. Products not in that roster (not cloned to the fleet root) may also appear here; empowera and documed do, because a freeze has to bind whether or not the repo is checked out locally.

scopePolicy.unclassifiedNote: Absence from this file never means allowed. An unlisted product is not eligible for mobile work; stop and ask the owner to classify it.

buckets.include: Eligible now. Build against the mobile-platform-standard skill.
buckets.evaluateLater: Not eligible. Native value is unproven; revisit when the product's own evidence justifies it. Identity is not frozen, but no mobile identifier may be reserved ahead of that decision either.
buckets.excludedPendingReposition: Not eligible, and identity is frozen. Every class in scopePolicy.frozenIdentifierClasses is prohibited until the recorded exitCondition is met.
buckets.noNative: Web, CLI, service, marketing, or infrastructure. No native mobile surface is intended.
